title: Modular Inverses
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: q. Each line: a m (m prime, 1 <= a < m).
Print a^(-1) mod m.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000; 2 ≤ m ≤ 2*10^9 (prime).

Binary exponentiation; the linear scan W times out on query one.

tests.name: third
seventh
load: 200000 queries
tests.hint: inv(5) = 400000003: 5 * 400000003 = 2p + 1. Every query is one log-time exponentiation; the O(m) scan W cannot finish the first.
